page: Microsoft Azure M416ds_9_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MDSHighMemoryv3 family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by Intel processors, running under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 416 dedicated virtual CPUs and a massive memory capacity of 8568.0 GB, yielding approximately 20.6 GB of RAM per core.

For storage, the server includes a 410 GB local SSD and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not feature any integrated GPUs, and it includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The hardware profile is designed for extreme resource density, prioritizing massive memory capacity over local storage volume.

This configuration is designed for workloads requiring vast memory footprints, such as large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy data warehousing operations. The high memory-to-vCPU ratio provides qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound applications by reducing the need to scale out across multiple smaller nodes.
